_doc: Team marks shown to IDENTIFY the team (nominative trademark use; no endorsement). Only files whose copyright status permits reuse (Commons PD-textlogo) are approved; trademarks remain with their owners. Files are never recoloured or cropped; dark-ink marks sit on a light chip (bg=light). Held teams fall back to the team name only.
approvedBy: owner request 2026-10-02 (show team logos next to team names)
